limits: No code changes, builds, tests, Actions, sf-ci, product UI or tenant calls were executed. All gate outcomes remain NOT_RUN.

No standalone Relay Python executable is included in the 219. The 49 tree-inventoried Python test files below were not body-read by this front; root owns the bounded follow-up.
Core entire 641-test text scan is not a semantic audit of 641 tests; 158 are the classified Core rows.

Source relationship extraction resolves string imports using package exports and relative paths; manually recorded process/helper parents cover the observed MCP spawned fixture. Dynamic runtime edges cannot be proven absent by text scan.

Other generic callers of shared fixtures remain listed under otherObservedTestCallers. The plan adds explicit opt-in admitted fixtures and preserves technical defaults; changing shared defaults would require reviewing those callers before implementation.
No core/src/sucafina/native-ui.ts exists in the complete Core tree. Native UI authority lives in the product/CLI front, not in an invented Core module.
A successful search for residual strings is insufficient: entrypoint instrumentation, private caches, durable ownership, packed-content checks and recovery gates are necessary.
Real Microsoft tenant, membership/admin/noTeams/reauth flows are outside this read-only task; their separate product verification is required before rollout.

contracts.decision: Canonical SF context includes installation, tenant, corporate principal, selected Team and configuration/access/policy revisions; distinct explicit admin-without-Team/noTeams branches. Client-supplied values are selectors, never authority.
Corporate admission precedes Location/Project resolution, private SELECT/materialization, config import, process/network and mutation on SF paths, including compiled generic CLI endpoints.

Share only immutable config keyed by Team+config revision; principal credentials, grants, MCP clients, provider/account/plugin handles and callbacks are isolated/revalidated. Revocation closes stale handles and prevents late callbacks repopulating caches.

Sessions, meetings after detach, schedules, private outputs and recovery records carry durable owner independent of cwd/project/session guesses. Exact IDs/import/fork/move/retry and list/cursor filters are owner-checked before materialization/pagination.

Team membership does not authorize every case/corpus/transcript/provider resource; installation resources and per-resource grants remain independent. Historical provenance bytes/IDs/digests are not rewritten into Team IDs.

Explicit old-owner mapping, quarantine ambiguous records, writer fence, atomic resumable cutover, immutable old migrations. Restore reconciles monotonic receipts/consumed slots/cancellations/issued IDs/high-water marks; uncertainty holds instead of redispatch.
Keep generic Project/Location/filesystem/repository utilities with positive technical tests, paired with negative SF tests proving they do not select profile or grant business access.
